summary: Associate a host with groups from its Groups tab (Associate groups), see its Completed Jobs, and create hosts in bulk with POST to /api/v2/bulk/host_create (unique hosts, all or nothing, OPTIONS shows the schema).
questions: How do I add many hosts at once via the API?
How do I add a host to multiple groups?
Where can I see jobs that ran on a host?

answer_card.title: Bulk create hosts
answer_card.answer_md: POST JSON to `/api/v2/bulk/host_create` with the target inventory and a list of hosts. Hosts must be unique in the inventory; either all are created or an error explains why none were. Send `OPTIONS` to the endpoint for the schema.
